description:
Set within a pleasant position and having en-suite and high rental yield. This first floor apartment with no onward chain is ideal for investors, first time buyers and downsizers. Situated just off Haughton Green and being within easy access to local amenities and the A66, this apartment also has allocated parking and is available to view now. Set on the first floor, the apartment is accessed via communal hallway with intercom. Internally the accommodation comprises an entrance hallway which gives access to a living room, kitchen, two bedrooms and bathroom. The living room is a spacious size and leads into the kitchen which is fitted with ample units. The main bedroom is a good sized double and benefits from en-suite shower room. The bathroom is partially tiled and fitted with a three piece suite. Externally the apartment has greenery area to the front and ample allocated parking to the rear.

COMMUNAL ENTRANCE Hallway with intercom and staircase to all floors.

ENTRANCE HALL U-shaped hallway with storage cupboard and access to all rooms.

LIVING ROOM Spacious room with window to the rear, ample space for both living and dining room furniture and access to the:

KITCHEN With window to the rear and fitted with wood effect units, dark worktops, tiled splashbacks, integrated oven/hob with extractor above, sink unit and space for appliances.

BEDROOM ONE Great sized double room with bay window to the rear.

EN-SUITE SHOWER ROOM Partially tiled with shower cubicle, wall mounted sink and w/c.

BEDROOM TWO Spacious single room. Please note this bedroom does not have a window.

BATHROOM Partially tiled and fitted with suite comprising bath, wall mounted sink and w/c.

EXTERNALLY The apartment has greenery area to the front and ample allocated parking to the rear.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band B Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
